description:
I'm an Artificial Intelligence student at Deakin University with experience in AI/ML, cybersecurity, software development, and international hackathons. I'm passionate about using NASA's data to develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges.

We're looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in AI, Python, web development, data science, Earth science, UI/UX design, and data visualization. All experience levels are welcome—let's collaborate, innovate, and build something impactful!
